contentText: President Donald Trump said on March 6 that only Iran's "unconditional surrender" would bring an end to the Middle East war. ⁠this comes as The Washington Post reports that Russia is providing Iran ⁠with targeting information ​that includes locations of U.S. warships and aircraft in the Middle East. On the eve of the first week of this war, FRANCE 24's Douglas Herbert looks at where the conflict stands.
